title.en: Between the village and the city

intro.en: A husband and wife talk about leaving the village and moving to the capital, near their children. Listen for the reasons each of them gives.
intro.ur: Miyan biwi baat karte hain ke gaon chhod kar daarul-hukumat mein bachchon ke paas jaayein ya nahin. Dekhein har ek kya wajah batata hai.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ زَوْجٌ وَزَوْجَةٌ عَنْ تَرْكِ القَرْيَةِ وَالانْتِقالِ إِلى العاصِمَةِ قُرْبَ أَوْلادِهِما. اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى سَبَبِ كُلٍّ مِنْهُما.

dialogue.ar: يا أَبا عَمْرو، ما رَأْيُكَ، نَتْرُكُ القَرْيَةَ، وَنَسْكُنُ في العاصِمَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: yā abā ʿAmr, mā raʾyuka, natruku l-qaryata wa naskunu fī l-ʿāṣimah?
dialogue.en: Abu Amr, what do you think? Shall we leave the village and live in the capital?
dialogue.ur: Abu Amr, aap ki kya raaye hai, hum gaon chhod kar daarul-hukumat mein rahein?

dialogue.ar: لَنا بَيْتٌ في القَرْيَةِ، وَلَيْسَ لَنا بَيْتٌ في العاصِمَةِ. لِماذا نَتْرُكُ بَيْتَنا، وَنَرْحَلُ إِلى هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: lanā baytun fī l-qaryah, wa laysa lanā baytun fī l-ʿāṣimah. limādhā natruku baytanā wa narḥalu ilā hunāk?
dialogue.en: We have a house in the village and no house in the capital. Why leave our house and go there?
dialogue.ur: Hamara ghar gaon mein hai, daarul-hukumat mein nahin. Hum apna ghar chhod kar wahan kyun jaayein?

dialogue.ar: أَوْلادُنا يَعيشونَ في العاصِمَةِ. حُسَيْنٌ يَدْرُسُ في الجامِعَةِ، وَمُحْسِنَةُ تَدْرُسُ في كُلِّيَّةِ المُعَلِّماتِ، وَحَسّانُ يَعْمَلُ في شَرِكَةٍ هُناكَ.
dialogue.tr: awlādunā yaʿīshūna fī l-ʿāṣimah. Ḥusaynun yadrusu fī l-jāmiʿah, wa Muḥsinatu tadrusu fī kulliyyati l-muʿallimāt, wa Ḥassānu yaʿmalu fī sharikatin hunāk.
dialogue.en: Our children live in the capital. Husayn studies at university, Muhsina studies at the teachers' college and Hassan works in a company there.
dialogue.ur: Hamare bachche daarul-hukumat mein rehte hain. Husain university mein parhta hai, Muhsina teachers college mein parhti hai aur Hassan wahan ek company mein kaam karta hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ نَتْرُكُ مَزْرَعَتَنا يا أُمَّ عَمْرو؟! سَيَموتُ الزَّرْعُ وَالشَّجَرُ.
dialogue.tr: hal natruku mazraʿatanā yā Umma ʿAmr?! sa-yamūtu z-zarʿu wash-shajar.
dialogue.en: Shall we leave our farm, Umm Amr?! The crops and trees will die.
dialogue.ur: Kya hum apna khet chhod dein, Umm Amr?! Fasal aur darakht sookh jaayenge.

dialogue.ar: أَنا خائِفَةٌ عَلى أَوْلادي. الحَوادِثُ كَثيرَةٌ في العاصِمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: anā khāʾifatun ʿalā awlādī. al-ḥawādithu kathīratun fī l-ʿāṣimah.
dialogue.en: I am worried about my children. Accidents are many in the capital.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe apne bachchon ki fikr hai. Daarul-hukumat mein hadsaat bahut hain.

dialogue.ar: أَنا لا أُحِبُّ العاصِمَةَ. أَنا أُحِبُّ بَيْتي وَمَزْرَعَتي.
dialogue.tr: anā lā uḥibbu l-ʿāṣimah. anā uḥibbu baytī wa mazraʿatī.
dialogue.en: I do not like the capital. I love my house and my farm.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe daarul-hukumat pasand nahin. Mujhe apna ghar aur khet pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا لا أُحِبُّ العاصِمَةَ أَيْضاً، فَهُناكَ التَّلَوُّثُ، وَالضَّوْضاءُ، وَالازْدِحامُ.
dialogue.tr: anā lā uḥibbu l-ʿāṣimata aydan, fa-hunāka t-talawwuthu waḍ-ḍawḍāʾu wal-izdiḥām.
dialogue.en: I do not like the capital either, there is pollution, noise and crowding.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe bhi daarul-hukumat pasand nahin, wahan pollution, shor aur bheed hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي القَرْيَةِ الأَهْلُ وَالجيرانُ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī l-qaryati l-ahlu wal-jīrān.
dialogue.en: And in the village there are family and neighbours.
dialogue.ur: Aur gaon mein rishtedaar aur parosi hain.

dialogue.ar: هَذا حَقٌّ، وَلَكِنَّكَ مَريضٌ، وَأَنا مَريضَةٌ أَيْضاً. نَحْنُ نَحْتاجُ إِلى أَوْلادِنا.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ḥaqq, wa lākinnaka marīḍ, wa anā marīḍatun aydan. naḥnu naḥtāju ilā awlādinā.
dialogue.en: That is true, but you are ill and I am ill too. We need our children.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sach hai, lekin aap beemar hain aur main bhi beemar hoon. Hamein apne bachchon ki zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُمْ يَحْتاجونَ إِلَيْنا أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: wa hum yaḥtājūna ilaynā aydan.
dialogue.en: And they need us too.
dialogue.ur: Aur unhein bhi hamari zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: نَبيعُ البَيْتَ وَالمَزْرَعَةَ، وَنَشْتَري بَيْتاً في العاصِمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: nabīʿu l-bayta wal-mazraʿah, wa nashtarī baytan fī l-ʿāṣimah.
dialogue.en: We sell the house and the farm and buy a house in the capital.
dialogue.ur: Hum ghar aur khet bech dein aur daarul-hukumat mein ghar kharid lein.

dialogue.ar: سَأَطْلُبُ مِنَ الأَوْلادِ أَنْ يَشْتَروا لَنا بَيْتاً هُناكَ.
dialogue.tr: sa-aṭlubu mina l-awlādi an yashtarū lanā baytan hunāk.
dialogue.en: I will ask the children to buy us a house there.
dialogue.ur: Main bachchon se kahoonga ke hamare liye wahan ghar kharid dein.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً يا أَبا عَمْرو.
dialogue.tr: jazāka llāhu khayran yā abā ʿAmr.
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you with good, Abu Amr.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko behtareen badla de, Abu Amr.

q.en: Why does the mother want to live in the capital?
q.ur: Maa daarul-hukumat mein kyun rehna chahti hai?
q.ar: لِماذا تُريدُ الأُمُّ أَنْ تَسْكُنَ في العاصِمَةِ؟

q.en: What does the father love?
q.ur: Baap ko kya pasand hai?

q.en: Which problems of the capital does the mother mention?
q.ur: Maa daarul-hukumat ke kaun se masail batati hai?
q.ar: أَيَّ مَشاكِلَ في العاصِمَةِ تَذْكُرُ الأُمُّ؟

q.en: What do they decide in the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein wo kya faisla karte hain?

options: Sell the house and farm and buy a house in the capital
options_ar: أَنْ يَبيعا البَيْتَ وَالمَزْرَعَةَ وَيَشْتَرِيا بَيْتاً في العاصِمَةِ

intro.en: Two sounds look alike: a long ee (ـِي, like in بِيع) and a soft ay (ـَيْ, like in بَيْع). Listen and notice the difference, then read the pairs.
intro.ur: Do awaazein milti julti hain: lambi "ee" (ـِي jaise بِيع) aur narm "ay" (ـَيْ jaise بَيْع). Suniye aur farq dekhiye, phir jodiyan parhein.
intro.ar: صَوْتانِ يَتَشابَهانِ: ياءُ المَدِّ (ـِي) مِثْلَ «بِيع»، وَياءُ اللِّينِ (ـَيْ) مِثْلَ «بَيْع». اِسْتَمِعْ وَلاحِظِ الفَرْقَ، ثُمَّ اقْرَأِ الأَزْواجَ.

q.en: Which word has a long ee sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi "ee" ki awaaz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها ياءُ مَدٍّ (صَوْتٌ طَويلٌ)؟

q.en: Which word has the soft ay sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein narm "ay" ki awaaz hai?

q.en: How is the soft yaa written?
q.ur: Narm yaa kaise likha jata hai?

q.en: Which pair shows the two sounds?
q.ur: Kaunsi jodi mein dono awaazein hain?

intro.en: The joining letters are و (and), ف (then, straight after), ثُمَّ (then, later) and أَوْ (or). The word after the letter follows the same ending as the word before it.
intro.ur: Huroof-e-atf yeh hain: و (aur), ف (phir, foran), ثُمَّ (phir, kuch der baad) aur أَوْ (ya). Harf ke baad wale lafz ka iraab pehle wale jaisa hota hai.
intro.ar: حُروفُ العَطْفِ هِيَ: و، ف (بَعْدَ مُباشَرَةٍ)، ثُمَّ (بَعْدَ مُهْلَةٍ)، أَوْ. وَتَتْبَعُ الكَلِمَةُ بَعْدَها إِعْرابَ الكَلِمَةِ الَّتي قَبْلَها.

dialogue.ar: التَّلَوُّثُ وَالجَريمَةُ وَالازْدِحامُ مِنْ مُشْكِلاتِ المُدُنِ.
dialogue.tr: at-talawwuthu wal-jarīmatu wal-izdiḥāmu min mushkilāti l-mudun.
dialogue.en: Pollution, crime and crowding are among the problems of cities.
dialogue.ur: Pollution, jurm aur bheed shehron ke masail mein se hain.

dialogue.ar: اِشْرَبْ شاياً أَوْ قَهْوَةً عِنْدَ أَخيكَ.
dialogue.tr: ishrab shāyan aw qahwatan ʿinda akhīk.
dialogue.en: Drink tea or coffee at your brother's.
dialogue.ur: Apne bhai ke paas chai ya coffee piyo.

dialogue.ar: صَلّى عَدْنانُ الظُّهْرَ، ثُمَّ العَصْرَ.
dialogue.tr: ṣallā ʿAdnānu ẓ-ẓuhr, thumma l-ʿaṣr.
dialogue.en: Adnan prayed Zuhr, then Asr.
dialogue.ur: Adnan ne Zuhr parhi, phir Asr.

dialogue.ar: سافَرْتُ إِلى القَرْيَةِ، فَالمَدينَةِ.
dialogue.tr: sāfartu ilā l-qaryah, fal-madīnah.
dialogue.en: I travelled to the village, then to the city.
dialogue.ur: Main gaon gaya, phir shehar.

dialogue.ar: أَدْرَكَتْ بَعْضُ الدُّوَلِ المُشْكِلَةَ، فَبَنَتِ المَصانِعَ.
dialogue.tr: adrakat baʿḍu d-duwali l-mushkilah, fa-banati l-maṣāniʿ.
dialogue.en: Some countries realised the problem, so they built factories.
dialogue.ur: Kuch mulkon ne masle ko samjha, phir factories banayeen.

q.en: Which letter means "or"?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf "ya" ka matlab deta hai?

q.en: Which letter means "then, after a while"?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf "phir, kuch der baad" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يُفيدُ الجَمْعَ بَعْدَ مُهْلَةٍ؟

q.en: Complete: لَدَيَّ قَلَمٌ، ... كِتابٌ
q.ur: Mukammal karein: لَدَيَّ قَلَمٌ، ... كِتابٌ

q.en: What do these letters do?
q.ur: Yeh harf kya karte hain?

options: Join a word to the one before it

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue about Abdurrahman's family, then say if each sentence is right or wrong. Then compare life in the city and in the village with a partner.
intro.ur: Abdurrahman ke khandaan ka mukaalma suniye aur har jumla sahi ya ghalat batayein. Phir shehar aur gaon ki zindagi ka muqabla karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ عَنْ أُسْرَةِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثُمَّ قُلْ إِنْ كانَتْ كُلُّ جُمْلَةٍ صَحيحَةً أَمْ خاطِئَةً. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ قارِنْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ بَيْنَ الحَياةِ في المَدينَةِ وَالقَرْيَةِ.

q.en: Which word means "noise"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "shor" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الصَّوْتِ العالي المُزْعِجِ؟

q.en: Which word means "life"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "zindagi" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المُدَّةِ الَّتي يَعيشُها الإِنْسانُ؟

q.en: Which word means "countryside"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "dehaat" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المَكانِ خارِجَ المُدُنِ حَيْثُ المَزارِعُ؟

q.en: Which word means "he bought"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "usne kharida" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني: أَخَذَ شَيْئاً بِالمالِ؟

title.ar: لِماذا يُفَضِّلُ بَعْضُ النّاسِ الحَياةَ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَة؟
title.en: Why do some people prefer life in big cities?
title.ur: Kuch log bade shehron ki zindagi ko kyun pasand karte hain?

intro.en: A reading text about life in big cities: their problems, why people still prefer them, why villagers migrate, and how city populations are growing.
intro.ur: Bade shehron ki zindagi ke baare mein ek paragraph: unke masail, phir bhi log unhein kyun pasand karte hain, dehati log kyun hijrat karte hain aur aabadi kaise barh rahi hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنِ الحَياةِ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ: مَشاكِلُها، وَلِماذا يُفَضِّلُها كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ، وَلِماذا يَنْتَقِلُ أَهْلُ القُرى إِلَيْها، وَكَيْفَ يَزيدُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها.

dialogue.ar: يَعيشُ مَلايينُ النّاسِ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ، مِثْلَ: طوكيو، وَلَنْدَن، وَنيويورْك، وَالقاهِرَة.
dialogue.tr: yaʿīshu malāyīnu n-nāsi fī l-mudun al-kabīrah, mithla Ṭūkyū, Landan, Niyūyūrk wal-Qāhirah.
dialogue.en: Millions of people live in big cities such as Tokyo, London, New York and Cairo.
dialogue.ur: Karoron log bade shehron mein rehte hain, jaise Tokyo, London, New York aur Qahira.

dialogue.ar: وَيُواجِهُ سُكّانُ المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ مُشْكِلاتٍ كَبيرَةً، مِثْلَ: التَّلَوُّثِ وَالجَريمَةِ وَالازْدِحامِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yuwājihu sukkānu l-mudun al-kabīrati mushkilātin kabīrah, mithla t-talawwuth wal-jarīmah wal-izdiḥām.
dialogue.en: City people face big problems such as pollution, crime and crowding.
dialogue.ur: Bade shehron ke log bade masail ka samna karte hain, jaise pollution, jurm aur bheed.

dialogue.ar: وَبِالرُّغْمِ مِنْ هَذِهِ المُشْكِلاتِ، يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ الحَياةَ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ؛ لِأَنَّ فيها المَصانِعَ وَالشَّرِكاتِ وَالجامِعاتِ وَالمَكْتَباتِ وَالمُسْتَشْفَياتِ وَالأَسْواقَ وَأَماكِنَ التَّرْويح.
dialogue.tr: wa bi-r-rughmi min hādhihi l-mushkilāt, yufaḍḍilu kathīrun mina n-nāsi l-ḥayāta fī l-mudun al-kabīrah; li-anna fīhā l-maṣāniʿa wash-sharikāt wal-jāmiʿāt wal-maktabāt wal-mustashfayāt wal-aswāq wa amākina t-tarwīḥ.
dialogue.en: Despite these problems, many people prefer life in big cities, because they have factories, companies, universities, libraries, hospitals, markets and places of recreation.
dialogue.ur: In masail ke bawajood bohat se log bade shehron ki zindagi pasand karte hain, kyunki wahan factoriyan, companyan, universities, libraries, hospital, bazaar aur tafreeh ki jagahein hain.

dialogue.ar: يَزْدادُ سُكّانُ المُدُنِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؛ لِأَنَّ سُكّانَ الرِّيفِ يُهاجِرونَ إِلَيْها لِلْعَمَلِ في المَصانِعِ وَالشَّرِكاتِ، وَيَتْرُكونَ العَمَلَ في الزِّراعَةِ وَالرَّعْيِ.
dialogue.tr: yazdādu sukkānu l-mudun kulla yawm; li-anna sukkāna r-rīf yuhājirūna ilayhā lil-ʿamal fī l-maṣāniʿ wash-sharikāt, wa yatrukūna l-ʿamala fiz-zirāʿati war-raʿy.
dialogue.en: City populations grow every day, because villagers migrate to them to work in factories and companies and leave farming and herding.
dialogue.ur: Shehron ki aabadi roz barhti hai, kyunki dehati log factoriyon aur companyon mein kaam ke liye wahan jaate hain aur kheti aur charwahi chhor dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَدْرَكَتْ بَعْضُ الدُّوَلِ هَذِهِ المُشْكِلَةَ: مُشْكِلَةَ الهِجْرَةِ مِنَ الرِّيفِ إِلى المَدينَةِ، فَبَنَتْ مَصانِعَ كَثيرَةً في الرِّيفِ، فَرَجَعَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ لِلْعَمَلِ في الرِّيفِ، وَالحَياةِ فيهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad adrakat baʿḍu d-duwali hādhihi l-mushkilah: mushkilata l-hijrati mina r-rīfi ilā l-madīnah, fa-banat maṣāniʿa kathīratan fir-rīf, fa-rajaʿa kathīrun mina n-nāsi lil-ʿamali fir-rīf wal-ḥayāti fīh.
dialogue.en: Some countries realised this problem, migration from countryside to city, so they built many factories in the countryside, and many people went back to work and live there.
dialogue.ur: Kuch mulkon ne is masle ko samjha, yaani dehaat se shehar ki taraf hijrat ko, to unhon ne dehaat mein bohat si factoriyan banayeen aur bohat se log kaam aur zindagi ke liye wapas chale gaye.

dialogue.ar: في القَرْنِ التّاسِعَ عَشَرَ المِيلادِيِّ كانَ يَسْكُنُ المُدُنَ نَحْوُ ٢٫٥٪ مِنْ سُكّانِ العالَمِ، ثُمَّ وَصَلَتِ النِّسْبَةُ إِلى نَحْوِ ٤٠٪ سَنَةَ ١٩٨٠م، وَوَصَلَتْ إِلى ٥٠٪ سَنَةَ ٢٠٠٠م.
dialogue.tr: fil-qarni t-tāsiʿa ʿashara l-mīlādī kāna yaskunu l-mudun naḥwu 2.5% min sukkāni l-ʿālam, thumma waṣalati n-nisbatu ilā naḥwi 40% sanata 1980m, wa waṣalat ilā 50% sanata 2000m.
dialogue.en: In the 19th century about 2.5% of the world's people lived in cities, then it reached about 40% in 1980 and 50% in 2000.
dialogue.ur: Unneesvin sadi mein dunya ki taqreeban 2.5 fisad aabadi shehron mein thi, phir 1980 mein taqreeban 40 fisad aur 2000 mein 50 fisad ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَسَيَبْلُغُ سُكّانُ العالَمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَمانِيَةِ مِلْيارات شَخْصٍ سَنَةَ ٢٠٢٥م، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa sa-yabluġu sukkānu l-ʿālami akthara min thamāniyati milyārāt shakhṣ sanata 2025m, in shāʾa llāh.
dialogue.en: The world's population will reach more than eight billion people in 2025, God willing.
dialogue.ur: 2025 mein dunya ki aabadi, insha'Allah, aath arab se zyada ho jayegi.

q.en: What problems do big cities face?
q.ur: Bade shehron ke masail kya hain?
q.ar: ما المَشاكِلُ الَّتي تُواجِهُ المُدُنَ الكَبيرَةَ؟

q.en: Why do many people prefer big cities?
q.ur: Bohat se log bade shehron ko kyun pasand karte hain?
q.ar: لِماذا يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ المُدُنَ الكَبيرَةَ؟

options: Factories, companies, universities and hospitals are there

q.en: Why do villagers move to the city?
q.ur: Dehati log shehar kyun jaate hain?
q.ar: لِماذا يَنْتَقِلُ أَهْلُ القُرى إِلى المَدينَةِ؟

options: To work in factories and companies

q.en: In the 19th century, about how much of the world lived in cities?
q.ur: Unneesvin sadi mein dunya ki kitni aabadi shehron mein thi?
q.ar: في القَرْنِ التّاسِعَ عَشَرَ، كَمْ كانَتْ نِسْبَةُ مَنْ يَعيشُ في المُدُنِ مِنْ سُكّانِ العالَمِ تَقْريباً؟

intro.en: The object is a noun with the ending -a (manṣūb). It names the thing the doer's action falls on. Example: تَرَكَ الأَبُ القَرْيَةَ, the father left the village, and القَرْيَةَ is the object.
intro.ur: Maf'ool bihi woh ism hai jis par fail ka kaam waqe hota hai; yeh mansoob hota hai (aakhir mein fatha). Misaal: تَرَكَ الأَبُ القَرْيَةَ, baap ne gaon chhora; القَرْيَةَ maf'ool bihi hai.
intro.ar: المَفْعولُ بِهِ اسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ بِالفَتْحَةِ، وَهُوَ ما وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ فِعْلُ الفاعِلِ. مِثالٌ: تَرَكَ الأَبُ القَرْيَةَ، فَـ«القَرْيَةَ» مَفْعولٌ بِهِ.

dialogue.ar: تَرَكَ الأَبُ القَرْيَةَ.
dialogue.tr: taraka l-abu l-qaryah.
dialogue.en: The father left the village.
dialogue.ur: Baap ne gaon chhor diya.

dialogue.ar: تَرَكَتِ الأُمُّ البَيْتَ.
dialogue.tr: tarakati l-ummu l-bayt.
dialogue.en: The mother left the house.
dialogue.ur: Maa ne ghar chhor diya.

dialogue.ar: يُحِبُّ الرَّجُلُ القَرْيَةَ.
dialogue.tr: yuḥibbu r-rajulu l-qaryah.
dialogue.en: The man loves the village.
dialogue.ur: Aadmi ko gaon pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: يَبيعُ مُحَمَّدٌ السَّيّارَةَ.
dialogue.tr: yabīʿu Muḥammadun s-sayyārah.
dialogue.en: Muhammad sells the car.
dialogue.ur: Muhammad gaari bechta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَشْتَري عَلِيٌّ المَزْرَعَةَ.
dialogue.tr: yashtarī ʿAliyyun l-mazraʿah.
dialogue.en: Ali buys the farm.
dialogue.ur: Ali khet kharidta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَدْرُسُ حُسَيْنٌ الطِّبَّ.
dialogue.tr: yadrusu Ḥusaynun aṭ-ṭibb.
dialogue.en: Husayn studies medicine.
dialogue.ur: Husain tibb parhta hai.

q.en: What is the object in «يَدْرُسُ حُسَيْنٌ الطِّبَّ»?
q.ur: «يَدْرُسُ حُسَيْنٌ الطِّبَّ» mein maf'ool bihi kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما المَفْعولُ بِهِ في «يَدْرُسُ حُسَيْنٌ الطِّبَّ»؟

q.en: What ending does the object have?
q.ur: Maf'ool bihi ke aakhir mein kya harkat hoti hai?
q.ar: ما حَرَكَةُ المَفْعولِ بِهِ في آخِرِهِ؟

q.en: Complete: أَكَلَ الطِّفْلُ ...
q.ur: Mukammal karein: أَكَلَ الطِّفْلُ ...

q.en: What does the object tell us?
q.ur: Maf'ool bihi kya batata hai?

options: Who or what the action fell on
options_ar: مَنْ أَوْ ما وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ

intro.en: A driver asks a traffic policeman for directions to the university. Notice the polite phrases and the words for direction: west, left, right.
intro.ur: Ek driver traffic wale se jaamia ka raasta poochta hai. Adab wale alfaaz aur samton ke alfaaz (maghrib, bayen, dayen) par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ سائِقٌ شُرْطِيَّ المُرورِ عَنِ الطَّريقِ إِلى الجامِعَةِ. لاحِظِ العِباراتِ المُهَذَّبَةَ وَكَلِماتِ الاتِّجاهِ: غَرْب، يَسار، يَمين.

dialogue.ar: لَوْ سَمَحْتَ، أَيْنَ تَقَعُ الجامِعَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: law samaḥta, ayna taqaʿu l-jāmiʿah?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the university?
dialogue.ur: Maaf kijiye, jaamia kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: تَقَعُ الجامِعَةُ غَرْبَ المَدينَةِ.
dialogue.tr: taqaʿu l-jāmiʿatu gharba l-madīnah.
dialogue.en: The university is west of the city.
dialogue.ur: Jaamia shehar ke maghrib mein hai.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ أَصِلُ إِلَيْها مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa aṣilu ilayhā min faḍlik?
dialogue.en: How do I get there, please?
dialogue.ur: Main wahan kaise pahunchoon, meharbani karke?

dialogue.ar: اِتَّجِهْ غَرْباً في شارِعِ طارِقِ بْنِ زِياد.
dialogue.tr: ittajih gharban fī shāriʿi Ṭāriq bni Ziyād.
dialogue.en: Head west on Tariq ibn Ziyad street.
dialogue.ur: Tariq bin Ziyad sadak par maghrib ki taraf jaiye.

dialogue.ar: أَتَّجِهُ غَرْباً في شارِعِ طارِقِ بْنِ زِياد.
dialogue.tr: attajihu gharban fī shāriʿi Ṭāriq bni Ziyād.
dialogue.en: I head west on Tariq ibn Ziyad street.
dialogue.ur: Main Tariq bin Ziyad sadak par maghrib ki taraf jaata hoon.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ الإِشارَةِ الضَّوْئِيَّةِ الثّالِثَةِ، اِنْعَطِفْ يَساراً في طَريقِ خالِدِ بْنِ الوَليد.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda l-ishārati ḍ-ḍawʾiyyati th-thālithah, inʿaṭif yasāran fī ṭarīqi Khālidi bni l-Walīd.
dialogue.en: At the third traffic light, turn left onto Khalid ibn al-Walid road.
dialogue.ur: Teesri traffic light par Khalid bin Walid road par bayen mur jaiye.

dialogue.ar: أَنْعَطِفُ يَساراً في طَريقِ خالِدِ بْنِ الوَليد.
dialogue.tr: anʿaṭifu yasāran fī ṭarīqi Khālidi bni l-Walīd.
dialogue.en: I turn left onto Khalid ibn al-Walid road.
dialogue.ur: Main Khalid bin Walid road par bayen murta hoon.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ الدَّوّارِ الأَوَّلِ، اِرْجِعْ في الطَّريقِ نَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda d-dawwāri l-awwal, irjiʿ fiṭ-ṭarīqi nafsih.
dialogue.en: At the first roundabout, go back along the same road.
dialogue.ur: Pehle chakkar (roundabout) par usi raste par wapas jaiye.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ الدَّوّارِ الأَوَّلِ، أَرْجِعُ في الطَّريقِ نَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda d-dawwāri l-awwal, arjiʿu fiṭ-ṭarīqi nafsih.
dialogue.en: At the first roundabout I go back along the same road.
dialogue.ur: Pehle roundabout par main usi raste par wapas jaata hoon.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ أَوَّلِ شارِعٍ، اِتَّجِهْ يَساراً.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda awwali shāriʿ, ittajih yasārā.
dialogue.en: At the first street, head left.
dialogue.ur: Pehli sadak par bayen taraf jaiye.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ أَوَّلِ شارِعٍ، أَتَّجِهُ يَساراً.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda awwali shāriʿ, attajihu yasārā.
dialogue.en: At the first street, I head left.
dialogue.ur: Pehli sadak par main bayen jaata hoon.

dialogue.ar: تَجِدُ صَيْدَلِيَّةً عِنْدَ الزّاوِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tajidu ṣaydaliyyatan ʿinda z-zāwiyah.
dialogue.en: You will find a pharmacy at the corner.
dialogue.ur: Corner par aapko dawakhana milega.

dialogue.ar: أَجِدُ صَيْدَلِيَّةً عِنْدَ الزّاوِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ajidu ṣaydaliyyatan ʿinda z-zāwiyah.
dialogue.en: I find a pharmacy at the corner.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe corner par dawakhana milta hai.

dialogue.ar: اِسْتَمِرَّ، وَبَعْدَ ٢٠٠ مِتْرٍ تَجِدُ المُسْتَشْفى الجامِعِيَّ عَنْ يَمينِكَ.
dialogue.tr: istamirr, wa baʿda miʾatay mitr tajidu l-mustashfā l-jāmiʿiyya ʿan yamīnik.
dialogue.en: Continue, and after 200 metres you will find the university hospital on your right.
dialogue.ur: Chalte rahiye, 200 meter baad university hospital aapke dayen taraf milega.

dialogue.ar: الجامِعَةُ مُقابِلَ المُسْتَشْفى.
dialogue.tr: al-jāmiʿatu muqābila l-mustashfā.
dialogue.en: The university is opposite the hospital.
dialogue.ur: Jaamia hospital ke samne hai.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً.
dialogue.tr: shukrā.
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً.
dialogue.tr: ʿafwā.
dialogue.en: You are welcome.
dialogue.ur: Koi baat nahin.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good

q.en: Where is the university?
q.ur: Jaamia kahan hai?

q.en: Which street does he follow west?
q.ur: Wo maghrib ki taraf kis sadak par jaye?

q.en: What will he find at the corner?
q.ur: Corner par use kya milega?

q.en: What does the policeman say after «شُكْراً»?
q.ur: «شُكْراً» ke baad police wala kya kehta hai?

intro.en: A sentence that starts with a noun has two parts: the mubtada' (the thing we talk about) and the khabar (what we say about it). Both end with -u (marfūʿ). Example: مَكَّةُ جَميلَةٌ, Makkah is beautiful.
intro.ur: Jo jumla ism se shuru ho uske do hisse hote hain: mubtada (jis ke baare mein baat ho) aur khabar (jo us ke baare mein kaha jaye). Dono marfoo' hote hain (damma). Misaal: مَكَّةُ جَميلَةٌ, Makkah khoobsurat hai.
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ الَّتي تَبْدَأُ بِاسْمٍ لَها جُزْآنِ: المُبْتَدَأُ (ما نَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْهُ) وَالخَبَرُ (ما نَقولُهُ عَنْهُ). وَكِلاهُما مَرْفوعانِ بِالضَّمَّةِ. مِثالٌ: مَكَّةُ جَميلَةٌ.

dialogue.ar: مَكَّةُ جَميلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: Makkatu jamīlah.
dialogue.en: Makkah is beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Makkah khoobsurat hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا مُسْلِمٌ.
dialogue.tr: anā muslim.
dialogue.en: I am Muslim.
dialogue.ur: Main musalman hoon.

dialogue.ar: الجامِعَةُ واسِعَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-jāmiʿatu wāsiʿah.
dialogue.en: The university is wide.
dialogue.ur: Jaamia kushada hai.

dialogue.ar: المَسْجِدانِ كَبيرانِ.
dialogue.tr: al-masjidāni kabīrān.
dialogue.en: The two mosques are big.
dialogue.ur: Dono masjidein bari hain.

dialogue.ar: الفَقْرُ مُشْكِلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-faqru mushkilah.
dialogue.en: Poverty is a problem.
dialogue.ur: Ghurbat ek masla hai.

dialogue.ar: دِمَشْقُ عاصِمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: Dimashqu ʿāṣimah.
dialogue.en: Damascus is a capital.
dialogue.ur: Dimashq daarul-hukumat hai.

dialogue.ar: القاهِرَةُ مُزْدَحِمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-Qāhiratu muzdaḥimah.
dialogue.en: Cairo is crowded.
dialogue.ur: Qahira bheed wala hai.

dialogue.ar: المَصانِعُ كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-maṣāniʿu kathīrah.
dialogue.en: The factories are many.
dialogue.ur: Factoriyan bohat hain.

q.en: In «الجامِعَةُ واسِعَةٌ», what is the mubtada'?
q.ur: «الجامِعَةُ واسِعَةٌ» mein mubtada kaun sa hai?

q.en: What is the khabar in «هَذا طَبيبٌ»?
q.ur: «هَذا طَبيبٌ» mein khabar kaun sa hai?

q.en: What ending do the mubtada' and khabar usually have?
q.ur: Mubtada aur khabar ke aakhir mein aam taur par kya harkat hoti hai?
q.ar: ما الحَرَكَةُ المُعْتادَةُ في آخِرِ المُبْتَدَأِ وَالخَبَرِ؟

q.en: Where does the mubtada' usually come?
q.ur: Mubtada aam taur par kahan aata hai?

options: At the start of the sentence

intro.en: Listen to a text about a family's visit to the city, then describe with a partner how Badr gets to the hospital, and discuss why people move between village and city.
intro.ur: Shehar mein ek khandaan ke daure ka text suniye, phir saathi ke saath batayein ke Badr hospital kaise pahunchega aur log gaon aur shehar ke darmiyan kyun jaate hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ زِيارَةِ أُسْرَةٍ لِلْمَدينَةِ، ثُمَّ صِفْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ كَيْفَ يَصِلُ بَدْرٌ إِلى المُسْتَشْفى، وَناقِشا لِماذا يَنْتَقِلُ النّاسُ بَيْنَ القَرْيَةِ وَالمَدينَةِ.

q.en: What does «شَمال» mean?
q.ur: «شَمال» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which of these is a place name?
q.ur: In mein se kaun si jagah hai?

q.en: Which is a problem of big cities?
q.ur: Bade shehron ka ek masla kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى مُشْكِلَةٍ في المُدُنِ الكَبيرَةِ؟

q.en: What does «حَديقَة» mean?
q.ur: «حَديقَة» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Dunya ke bade shehron mein se

intro.en: A reading text about three big cities: Tokyo, Cairo and New York. It tells where each is, how many people live there, and what it is known for.
intro.ur: Teen bade shehron ke baare mein paragraph: Tokyo, Qahira aur New York. Kahan hain, kitni aabadi hai aur kis cheez ke liye mashhoor hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ ثَلاثِ مُدُنٍ كَبيرَةٍ: طوكيو وَالقاهِرَةِ وَنيويورك. يَذْكُرُ أَيْنَ تَقَعُ كُلٌّ مِنْها، وَكَمْ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها، وَبِماذا تُعْرَفُ.

dialogue.ar: طوكيو عاصِمَةُ اليابانِ، وَيَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها نَحْوَ عَشَرَةِ مَلايينِ شَخْصٍ.
dialogue.tr: Ṭūkyū ʿāṣimatu l-Yābān, wa yabluġu ʿadadu sukkānihā naḥwa ʿasharati malāyīni shakhṣ.
dialogue.en: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and its population is about ten million.
dialogue.ur: Tokyo Japan ka daarul-hukumat hai aur uski aabadi taqreeban ek karor hai.

dialogue.ar: في طوكيو مَقَرُّ الإِمْبِراطورِ وَالحُكومَةِ، وَفيها المَصارِفُ وَالشَّرِكاتُ، وَتَكْثُرُ فيها العِماراتُ العالِيَةُ.
dialogue.tr: fī Ṭūkyū maqarru l-imbarāṭūri wal-ḥukūmah, wa fīhā l-maṣārifu wash-sharikāt, wa taktharu fīhā l-ʿimārātu l-ʿāliyah.
dialogue.en: In Tokyo are the seat of the emperor and the government, banks and companies, and many tall buildings.
dialogue.ur: Tokyo mein badshah aur hukumat ka markaz hai, bank aur companyan hain aur unchi imaratein bohat hain.

dialogue.ar: تُواجِهُ طوكيو مُشْكِلاتٍ كَثيرَةً، مِثْلَ: الازْدِحامِ، وَالتَّلَوُّثِ، وَالزَّلازِلِ.
dialogue.tr: tuwājihu Ṭūkyū mushkilātin kathīrah, mithla l-izdiḥām, wat-talawwuth waz-zalāzil.
dialogue.en: Tokyo faces many problems such as crowding, pollution and earthquakes.
dialogue.ur: Tokyo bohat se masail ka samna karta hai, jaise bheed, pollution aur zalzale.

dialogue.ar: القاهِرَةُ عاصِمَةُ مِصْرَ، وَأَكْبَرُ مُدُنِها، تَقَعُ عَلى نَهْرِ النّيلِ، وَيَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِها نَحْوَ ثَمانِيَةِ مَلايينِ شَخْصٍ.
dialogue.tr: al-Qāhiratu ʿāṣimatu Miṣr, wa akbaru mudunihā, taqaʿu ʿalā nahri n-Nīl, wa yabluġu ʿadadu sukkānihā naḥwa thamāniyati malāyīni shakhṣ.
dialogue.en: Cairo is the capital of Egypt and its largest city. It lies on the River Nile and has about eight million people.
dialogue.ur: Qahira Misr ka daarul-hukumat aur sabse bara shehar hai. Yeh Nile darya par hai aur aabadi taqreeban assi lakh hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتُشْتَهَرُ بِأَنَّها مَدينَةُ المَآذِنِ، لِكَثْرَةِ مَساجِدِها، وَمِنْ تِلْكَ المَساجِدِ: مَسْجِدُ عَمْرِو بْنِ العاصِ، وَمَسْجِدُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ طولون، وَمَسْجِدُ السُّلْطانِ حَسَن، وَمَسْجِدُ مُحَمَّد عَلي، وَمَسْجِدُ الأَزْهَر.
dialogue.tr: wa tushtaharu bi-annahā madīnatu l-maʾādhin, li-kathrati masājidihā, wa min tilka l-masājid: masjidu ʿAmri bni l-ʿĀṣ, wa masjidu Aḥmada bni Ṭūlūn, wa masjidu s-Sulṭān Ḥasan, wa masjidu Muḥammad ʿAlī, wa masjidu l-Azhar.
dialogue.en: It is famous as the city of minarets because of its many mosques, among them the mosques of Amr ibn al-As, Ahmad ibn Tulun, Sultan Hasan, Muhammad Ali and al-Azhar.
dialogue.ur: Yeh minaron ka shehar mashhoor hai kyunki isme masjidein bohat hain, jaise Amr bin Al-Aas, Ahmad bin Tulun, Sultan Hasan, Muhammad Ali aur Al-Azhar ki masjidein.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَصْبَحَ الأَزْهَرُ الآنَ جامِعَةً إِسْلامِيَّةً كَبيرَةً، يَدْرُسُ فيها اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَالعُلومَ الإِسْلامِيَّةَ طُلّابٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دُوَلِ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad aṣbaḥa l-Azharu l-āna jāmiʿatan islāmiyyatan kabīrah, yadrusu fīhā l-lugha l-ʿarabiyyata wal-ʿulūma l-islāmiyyata ṭullābun min kulli duwali l-ʿālam.
dialogue.en: Al-Azhar has now become a large Islamic university where students from all countries study Arabic and the Islamic sciences.
dialogue.ur: Al-Azhar ab ek bari islami jaamia ban chuki hai jahan duniya ke har mulk ke talaba arabi zaban aur islami uloom parhte hain.

dialogue.ar: نيويورك أَكْبَرُ مَدينَةٍ في الوِلاياتِ المُتَّحِدَةِ الأَمْريكِيَّةِ، وَيوجَدُ فيها مَقَرُّ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ، وَالمَصارِفُ وَالشَّرِكاتُ.
dialogue.tr: Niyūyūrk akbaru madīnatin fil-Wilāyāti l-Muttaḥidati l-Amrīkiyyah, wa yūjadu fīhā maqarru l-Umami l-Muttaḥidah wal-maṣārifu wash-sharikāt.
dialogue.en: New York is the largest city in the United States. It has the seat of the United Nations, banks and companies.
dialogue.ur: New York Amriki riyasaton ka sabse bara shehar hai. Wahan United Nations ka markaz, bank aur companyan hain.

dialogue.ar: يَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِ نيويورك نَحْوَ سَبْعَةِ مَلايينِ شَخْصٍ، وَقَدْ هاجَرَ إِلَيْها النّاسُ مِنْ كُلِّ دُوَلِ العالَمِ لِلْعَمَلِ وَطَلَبِ العِلْم. تَكْثُرُ فيها ناطِحاتُ السَّحابِ.
dialogue.tr: yabluġu ʿadadu sukkāni Niyūyūrk naḥwa sabʿati malāyīni shakhṣ, wa qad hājara ilayhā n-nāsu min kulli duwali l-ʿālam lil-ʿamali wa ṭalabi l-ʿilm. taktharu fīhā nāṭiḥātu s-saḥāb.
dialogue.en: New York has about seven million people. People from all over the world have migrated there to work and seek knowledge. Skyscrapers are many there.
dialogue.ur: New York ki aabadi taqreeban 70 lakh hai. Duniya bhar se log kaam aur ilm ke liye wahan gaye hain. Wahan aasman choone wali imaratein bohat hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتُواجِهُ المَدينَةُ مُشْكِلاتٍ كَثيرَةً مِثْلَ: الفَقْرِ وَالجَريمَةِ وَالمُخَدِّراتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa tuwājihu l-madīnatu mushkilātin kathīratan mithla l-faqr wal-jarīmah wal-mukhaddirāt.
dialogue.en: The city faces many problems such as poverty, crime and drugs.
dialogue.ur: Shehar bohat se masail ka samna karta hai, jaise ghurbat, jurm aur nashe.

q.en: What is Tokyo?
q.ur: Tokyo kya hai?

q.en: On which river is Cairo?
q.ur: Qahira kis darya par hai?

q.en: What is New York known for in the text?
q.ur: Text mein New York kis cheez ke liye mashhoor hai?

q.en: About how many people live in Cairo?
q.ur: Qahira mein taqreeban kitne log rehte hain?

intro.en: A verb has three kinds. The past (māḍī) tells what happened before now. The present (muḍāriʿ) tells what happens now or later. The command (amr) asks for something to be done. Example: كَتَبَ (he wrote), يَكْتُبُ (he writes), اُكْتُبْ (write!).
intro.ur: Fe'l ki teen qismein hain. Maazi: jo pehle ho chuka. Muzare': jo abhi ya baad mein ho. Amr: kuch karne ka hukm. Misaal: كَتَبَ (usne likha), يَكْتُبُ (wo likhta hai), اُكْتُبْ (likho).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ ثَلاثَةُ أَنْواعٍ: الماضي لِما حَدَثَ قَبْلَ الآنِ، وَالمُضارِعُ لِما يَحْدُثُ الآنَ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ، وَالأَمْرُ لِطَلَبِ فِعْلِ شَيْءٍ. مِثالٌ: كَتَبَ، يَكْتُبُ، اُكْتُبْ.

q.en: Which kind of verb is «رَجَعَ»?
q.ur: «رَجَعَ» kis qism ka fe'l hai?

q.en: Which kind of verb is «يَشْرَبُ»?
q.ur: «يَشْرَبُ» kis qism ka fe'l hai?

q.en: Which kind of verb is «اِشْرَبْ»?
q.ur: «اِشْرَبْ» kis qism ka fe'l hai?

q.en: What is the command of «سافَرَ»?
q.ur: «سافَرَ» ka amr kya hai?

intro.en: Practise what you learned: spot the past, present and command forms, and put sentences in order. Study the pages and try the exercises by yourself.
intro.ur: Jo seekha hai uski mashq karein: maazi, muzare' aur amr pehchaniye aur jumlon ko tarteeb dein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى ما تَعَلَّمْتَ: مَيِّزِ الماضيَ وَالمُضارِعَ وَالأَمْرَ، وَرَتِّبِ الجُمَلَ. اُدْرُسِ الصَّفَحاتِ وَجَرِّبِ التَّمارينَ بِنَفْسِكَ.

q.en: What do we call a verb that asks for something to be done?
q.ur: Jo fe'l kuch karne ka hukm de use kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نُسَمّي الفِعْلَ الَّذي يَطْلُبُ فِعْلَ شَيْءٍ؟

q.en: Which is a past verb?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l maazi hai?

q.en: Which is a present verb?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l muzare' hai?

q.en: Which is a command?
q.ur: Kaun sa amr hai?

title.ur: Likhne ki mashq, khat aur imla

intro.en: Write about a picture of a busy road, write on the topic Life in the City, and learn the spelling rule: most words are written as they sound, with a few exceptions.
intro.ur: Bheed wali sadak ki tasveer par likhein, "zindagi shehar mein" par mazmoon likhein aur imla ka qaida seekhein: aksar alfaaz jaise bole jaate hain waise likhe jaate hain, chand ke ilawa.
intro.ar: اُكْتُبْ عَنْ صورَةٍ لِطَريقٍ مُزْدَحِمٍ، وَاكْتُبْ في مَوْضوعِ «الحَياةُ في المَدينَةِ»، وَتَعَلَّمْ قاعِدَةَ الإِمْلاءِ: أَكْثَرُ الكَلِماتِ تُكْتَبُ كَما تُنْطَقُ، وَلَها اسْتِثْناءاتٌ قَليلَةٌ.

dialogue.ar: فَتَحَ عَمْرُو بْنُ العاصِ مِصْرَ.
dialogue.tr: fataḥa ʿAmru bnu l-ʿĀṣi Miṣr.
dialogue.en: Amr ibn al-As conquered Egypt.
dialogue.ur: Amr bin Al-Aas ne Misr fatah kiya.

dialogue.ar: المُسْلِمونَ فَرِحوا حينَما انْتَصَروا.
dialogue.tr: al-muslimūna fariḥū ḥīnamā intaṣarū.
dialogue.en: The Muslims rejoiced when they won.
dialogue.ur: Musalman khush hue jab wo kamyab hue.

dialogue.ar: الطَّبيبُ وَالطَّبيبَةُ فَحَصا المَرضى.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭabību waṭ-ṭabībatu faḥaṣā l-marḍā.
dialogue.en: The doctor (m.) and doctor (f.) examined the patients.
dialogue.ur: Doctor aur doctora ne mareezon ko dekha.

dialogue.ar: ما اسْمُكَ؟ اِسْمِي الطّاهِرُ.
dialogue.tr: mā ismuk? ismī ṭ-Ṭāhir.
dialogue.en: What is your name? My name is at-Tahir.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka naam kya hai? Mera naam Tahir hai.

q.en: What is the title of the topic to write?
q.ur: Mazmoon ka unwan kya hai?

q.en: Which handwriting style does the book ask for?
q.ur: Kitab kis khat mein likhne ko kehti hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَوْعٍ مِنَ الخَطِّ يَطْلُبُهُ الكِتابُ؟

q.en: Which letter is written but not pronounced in «عَمْرو»?
q.ur: «عَمْرو» mein kaun sa harf likha jata hai lekin bola nahin jata?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يُكْتَبُ وَلا يُنْطَقُ في «عَمْرو»؟

q.en: In «الطَّبيب», what is written but not pronounced?
q.ur: «الطَّبيب» mein kya likha jata hai lekin bola nahin jata?
q.ar: في «الطَّبيب» ما الَّذي يُكْتَبُ وَلا يُنْطَقُ؟

intro.en: A review of earlier units: read a short text, then practise plurals, prepositions and punctuation marks. In the reading, a husband describes his wife's working day.
intro.ur: Pichli ikaiyon ki dohrai: ek chhota paragraph parhein, phir jama, huroof-e-jar aur alamat-e-tarqeem ki mashq karein.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِوَحَداتٍ سابِقَةٍ: اِقْرَأْ نَصّاً قَصيراً، ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الجُموعِ وَحُروفِ الجَرِّ وَعَلاماتِ التَّرْقيمِ. في النَّصِّ يَصِفُ زَوْجٌ يَوْمَ عَمَلِ زَوْجَتِهِ.

q.en: Which is the plural of «مَدْرَسَة»?
q.ur: «مَدْرَسَة» ka jama kaun sa hai?

q.en: Which word is the plural of «مَسْجِد»?
q.ur: «مَسْجِد» ka jama kaun sa hai?

q.en: Complete: تَذْهَبُ ... المَسْجِدِ
q.ur: Mukammal karein: تَذْهَبُ ... المَسْجِدِ

q.en: Which mark ends a question?
q.ur: Sawal ke aakhir mein kaun si alamat aati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عَلامَةٍ تُوضَعُ في نِهايَةِ السُّؤالِ؟
